title: Motorbike with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='16' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='12' fill='#7b68ee'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='5' fill='#c0c0e0'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='72' r='16' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='72' r='12' fill='#7b68ee'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='72' r='5' fill='#c0c0e0'/>
  <!-- frame / body -->
  <path d='M28 60 L45 40 L65 40 L78 60' stroke='#ff6b35' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x='40' y='52' width='24' height='14' rx='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <rect x='44' y='55' width='16' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- seat -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='38' rx='14' ry='5' fill='#ff4757'/>
  <!-- fuel tank -->
  <rect x='52' y='32' width='20' height='12' rx='5' fill='#ff6b35'/>
  <!-- handlebars -->
  <line x1='68' y1='34' x2='76' y2='26' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='24' x2='82' y2='24' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='44' r='6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='44' r='3' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <!-- face on the fuel tank / body -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M56 41 Q62 47 68 41' stroke='#1a1a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ff9eb5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='18' y='64' width='14' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c0c0e0'/>
  <rect x='14' y='62' width='6' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e0e0f0'/>
  <!-- fork -->
  <line x1='78' y1='60' x2='78' y2='56' stroke='#c0c0e0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M18 60 Q28 54 38 60' stroke='#ff4757' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
